# Contributing

PRs welcome. Please:
- Build it: `pip install ufbt && ufbt update && ufbt` (OFW) — CI builds on both
  Official and Unleashed and runs cppcheck.
- Keep the C style consistent with the existing file (clang-format-ish, 4-space).
- No new runtime dependencies beyond the Flipper SDK.
- For UI changes, attach a screenshot.
